title: Integration database port in Gradle
root_cause: The Gradle test configuration changed the JDBC port from 5432 to 5433. The PostgreSQL service is published on 5432, so the test connection to localhost:5433 is refused.

relevant_evidence.why: The service publishes PostgreSQL on port 5432 and becomes healthy.
The test fails when the JDBC driver connects to port 5433.
The Gradle test task supplies the JDBC URL.
